definitions.weaponContributionPointsPer1000GrossGear: 1000 × checkpoint weaponGainPercent / (cumulative spent − expansionSpend); includes purchase and enhancement spending on all gear, dropped gear and rebirth effects; descriptive, not causal purchase ROI. Zero spend is undefined and explicitly counted, not silently removed.
definitions.topWeaponTemplates: Top five by pooled equipped weapon minutes; denominator is all equipped weapon minutes within this policy/horizon. Accessory template minutes were not recorded; identical four-copy uptime was recorded.
definitions.spendingFractionOfAvailableGold: Cumulative spending / (ordinary gold income + sale proceeds + initial wealthy fixture funds). Median component amounts do not sum to a median identity.
